metadata.host_selection_rule: storage-only: direct child contract with most references; lexical canonical-id tie-break

semantics.source_rule: Derived result records exact contributing source/field lineage.
semantics.visibility_rule: Output visibility is constrained by all applicable contributing source governance.
semantics.join_rule: Cross-source joins never elevate the least-authorized source into broader visibility.
semantics.aggregate_rule: Aggregation may reduce detail but does not automatically remove governance/classification.
semantics.cache_rule: Cached result retains governance context and cannot be replayed under a broader caller context without re-evaluation.
semantics.materialize_rule: Materialized output receives explicit destination governance plus propagated source classification/lineage.
semantics.declassification_rule: Any reduction in restrictions requires explicit authorized declassification/sanitization.
semantics.authority_rule: Derived-result availability never creates new AccessCore rights.

invariants.rule: DWH governance may restrict or project data according to exact schema/classification/scope policy but never creates AccessCore rights, semantic ownership or broader visibility than the underlying authorized source set.

hard_gates.condition: cache served under broader caller context
join uses most permissive source policy

references.purpose: Join governance propagates across exact source lineage.
Aggregation retains governance unless explicitly declassified.
Cache does not bypass current governance.
